decisions.reason: The burner component builds directly on the firm's core gas radiant heater expertise, so it is easy to assimilate and improve within existing R&D.
The electric infrared panel heater extends the firm's radiant heating knowledge into electrification, and with its own product page the firm appears committed to learning in this growing segment.
The halogen infrared heater uses the same radiant heat transfer principles the firm knows well, giving it the capacity to interpret market feedback and refine the product.
The industrial electric hall heater fits the firm's established industrial hall heating customer base and application know-how, making it a close and strategically important extension.
The hydrogen-capable dark radiator builds on core gas infrared technology, is already in real operation, and offers valuable learning for decarbonisation, which justifies continued development.
